title: GET /compliance-frameworks catalog list still returns a well-formed pagination object post-deploy
expectedResult: 200 response with data[] and pagination{ page, limit, total, pages } all present and numeric — no schema drift on the shared catalog endpoint other modules (Smart Compliance, Vendor, Policy) also depend on.

title: available-frameworks entries still carry isAdded and isLicensed flags after a deploy
steps: Inspect one entry from the frameworks array
expectedResult: Each entry has boolean isAdded and isLicensed fields (not undefined), plus controlCount — the two flags FrameworksManager.jsx relies on to decide Activate/Deactivate/Upgrade Required button state.

title: Activate/Deactivate buttons remain permission-gated after UI changes
preconditions: User has compliance.read but neither compliance.create nor compliance.delete
steps: Inspect an active and an inactive framework tile
expectedResult: Neither Activate nor Deactivate buttons are rendered for this user (PermissionHide hides them) — 'View Compliance Map' remains visible if applicable.

title: Controls within a domain remain naturally sorted (A.5.2 before A.5.10) after any compliance-map change
description: controlsByDomain sorts requirementCode with localeCompare(..., {numeric:true}) specifically to avoid lexicographic ordering putting A.5.10 before A.5.2.
preconditions: A domain contains at least controls A.5.2, A.5.9 and A.5.10
steps: Open the compliance map for a framework with this domain
Expand the domain and read the control order
expectedResult: Order is A.5.2, A.5.9, A.5.10 — not A.5.10, A.5.2, A.5.9 (which a plain string sort would produce).

title: Refresh button is disabled while loading and when no project is selected
steps: Select a project and observe the button state during the initial data load
expectedResult: Refresh is disabled (isDisabled={!projectId || loading}) in both states, preventing a call to refreshProjectSummary with an undefined projectId.
